question: How did the Medical Termination of Pregnancy (Amendment) Act, 2021 extend the legal abortion framework in India?

options.text: Increased gestational limit for termination to 24 weeks for special cases
Restricted abortion access only to married women
Allowed termination solely on the discretion of healthcare providers
Made abortion legal for all pregnancies up to 30 weeks

solution:
The correct answer is __**Increased gestational limit for termination to 24 weeks for special cases**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Medical Termination of Pregnancy (Amendment) Act, 2021 extended the permissible gestational limit for abortion from **20 weeks to 24 weeks for certain categories of women**, such as survivors of rape, incest, minors, and other vulnerable women.
